import numpy as np


def r(x):
    # Quantize x to the nearest multiple of 0.01, which maps it to the
    # center of the rounding bin. This preserves the exact value of
    # round(100 * x) and hence the posterior mean.
    return float(round(100.0 * x) / 100.0)


def R(y_orig, y_new):
    # The output should remain identical (within numerical precision)
    return abs(y_orig - y_new) < 1e-6
